spans.s: RS0235 ताडनक्षमम् tāḍanakṣamam Withstands hammering – malleability
AF2226 ताडयत् इव tāḍayat iva Beating like pain
SV0276 ताडाग tāḍāga Tank / pond water- water which comes from higher levels and blocked by artificial means. Some peoples call Pushkarni’s as Tāḍāga. Sweet in taste and easy to digest.
AF2227 ताडित गुण दर्शनं tāḍita guṇa darśanaṁ Sees lightening before eyes
